did: I made the conversation video essay 'More hands, one door', about GitHub runners and the one serial gate every agent's change waits at, through all seven steps on the epic: your takes, six podcast versions to a green light, the signature with your overrides, and the rendered video, its thumbnail and description, delivered to Drive for you to upload by hand. Then I built the living cast it showed was missing (HOST5, #3570, merged): every character on screen now lives, speaking or not, with a mouth that moves with its words, a spring, sway and bob, a sweat drop when it talks a long time, play in its silences, and a point toward what it talks about; its emotion is a note that shows a few seconds and fades, the cast blends from pose to pose without ghosting, and it never covers the captions. You approved its preview, recorded as your call C1549. A fresh review then found two defects, which are in a draft, #3581, held for the coordinator's go.

calls.title: How big the host is drawn, now that it stays above the captions (C1566)
options: medium 0.56 and long 0.37 of the smaller area, drawn 1.2 times larger inside its corner bubble
keep 0.5 and 0.26, which drew a long host about two thirds as tall as before
calls.why: A long host keeps its size on a landscape video and the medium one leaves room above the captions; inside its bubble the character fills it to the rim, as the essay's picture-in-picture did.
calls.undo: Say which shot reads too big or small; the sizes move in one place and a new preview shows them.

calls.title: A character that isn't speaking still lives (C1567)
options: it breathes, sways, plays now and then in its silence, and its sign pulses and fades
it breathes and sways but never plays
it holds its sign, still, as before
calls.why: Your words: no moment where it just stands still, and a sign shows a few seconds and fades. The preview page shows the listener beside the version you approved.
calls.undo: Say the listener fidgets too much; how often it plays is one number, and #3580 proposes it waits for a pause in the conversation.

calls.title: How your takes were cleaned for the essay
options: a highpass and noise reduction, and silences cut where the loudness drops, not at word times
silences cut at the transcriber's word times
calls.why: Cutting at word times was choppy and kept the microphone's start-up hiss you flagged; cutting by loudness, measured against your own speech level, removed both.
calls.undo: A future essay can take your takes raw, or ask for a lighter clean.

left: #3580 item 3, a listener's play waiting for a pause in the conversation: it needs to know when the other character speaks, so I proposed a 'hears' field filled by #3567's seam and an A/B preview for you; the coordinator decides when.
#3577, drawing the cast inside the cards render: the essay's cast came from a stopgap screenshot pass of 46 ms a frame, while drawing a frame takes 0.3 ms.
#3581 is a draft, held for the coordinator's go under your rule on runner waste.

The essay's render went through stopgaps never committed: a stub speaker serving recorded takes with their word timings, which is the shape #3567's seam should take, a raised length cap, and a Playwright browser path alias.
The service account still has writer access on the essay's video file in Drive; the connector can't remove it, so it's yours to remove in Drive's sharing settings.
